title: Affine localization near an arbitrary closed subset
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $I\subseteq A$ any ideal, and $T=\operatorname{Spec}A$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. Put $C=V(I)=\{\mathfrak q:I\subseteq\mathfrak q\}$ and $S=\{s\in A:s\bmod I\text{ is a unit in }A/I\}$. Let $B=S^{-1}A$ be the ring of fractions $a/s$ with $a\in A$ and $s\in S$, where $a/s=a\prime/s\prime$ if some $t\in S$ annihilates $as\prime-a\prime s$, and let $h:\operatorname{Spec}B\to T$ be the canonical morphism. Then $h$ is weakly etale [def-weil-weakly-etale-morphism] and a homeomorphism onto $\{\mathfrak p:\exists\mathfrak q\supseteq I,\ \mathfrak p\subseteq\mathfrak q\}$, the points of $T$ specializing to $C$. In particular its image contains $C$, and every point of $\operatorname{Spec}B$ specializes within $\operatorname{Spec}B$ to a point whose image lies in $C$. No finite-generation hypothesis on $I$ or on the closed subset $C$ is imposed.

proof.text: Use the Mathlib localization spectrum theorems, represented by `lem-weil-pbc-localization-spectrum-embedding`, to identify the range with primes disjoint from `S` and obtain the embedding.

If `p ≤ q` and `I ≤ q`, an element of `S` in `p` has a quotient inverse; lifting that inverse to `A` gives `a*b - 1 ∈ I`, and hence `1 ∈ q`, a contradiction. Conversely, if `p` is disjoint from `S`, `p ⊔ I` is proper: a decomposition of `1` would make the `p` summand a quotient unit. Put `p ⊔ I` in a maximal ideal using `Ideal.exists_le_maximal`, then regard that maximal ideal as a prime.

proof.text: Taking `p = q` proves the image contains `V(I)`. For a localization prime `x`, choose `q` above its contraction and then choose `y` over `q` from the image description. The inclusion of contracted ideals lifts to `x ≤ y` by `IsLocalization.under_le_under_iff`, hence `Specializes x y` by the spectrum specialization-order theorem.

lean.statement: theorem affineClosedSpecializationLocalization (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (I : Ideal A) (S : Submonoid A) (hS : ∀ a : A, a ∈ S ↔ IsUnit (Ideal.Quotient.mk I a)) : WeaklyEtale (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A (Localization S)))) ∧ Topology.IsEmbedding (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap A (Localization S))) ∧ Set.range (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap A (Localization S))) = {p : PrimeSpectrum A | ∃ q : PrimeSpectrum A, I ≤ q.asIdeal ∧ p.asIdeal ≤ q.asIdeal} ∧ {q : PrimeSpectrum A | I ≤ q.asIdeal} ⊆ Set.range (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap A (Localization S))) ∧ ∀ x : PrimeSpectrum (Localization S), ∃ y : PrimeSpectrum (Localization S), Specializes x y ∧ I ≤ (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap A (Localization S)) y).asIdeal
